claim.claim-text: 1. An implant (550) configured for compressing a joint (2) between a first bone portion (6) and a second bone portion (5), wherein a cavity (20) is located within the joint (2) between the first bone portion (6) and the second bone portion (5), the implant (550) comprising:

2. The implant (550) of claim 1, wherein the lag zone (560) comprises a fenestration opening (556) into a central longitudinal bore (551), wherein the fenestration opening (556) is configured to be filled with bone graft material (15).

3. The implant (550) of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the washer member (554) comprises a bore (555) having a central bore axis (582) and the washer member central bore axis (582) is configured to be angled with respect to the screw member longitudinal axis (557) within the range of at least -8 degrees to at least +8 degrees.

4. The implant (550) of any preceding claim, wherein the implant (550) is a sacro-ilial fusion implant and the joint (2) is a sacro-iliac joint, and wherein the first bone portion (6) is an ilium, and the second bone (5) portion is a sacrum, and the cavity (20) is located between the ilium and the sacrum.
5. The implant (550) of any preceding claim, wherein the fusion zone (565) is configured to be positioned to cross the first bone portion (6) and extend into the cavity (20).
6. The implant (550) of claim 5, wherein the fusion zone (565) is further configured to be positioned to contact the second bone portion (5).
7. The implant of any preceding claim, wherein the screw member (552) includes a bore (551) extending along its lengthwise dimension to allow for introduction over a guide wire (400).
8. The implant of claim 7, wherein the screw member further comprises one or more fenestrations (556) which open into the bore (551) for graft packing and bone through-growth.

9. The implant of any preceding claim, wherein a semispherical capsule (553) is positioned between the proximal (570) and distal (572) sides of the washer member (554) and the semispherical connection between the head (566) and the washer member (554) permits polyaxial orientation of the screw member (552) relative to the washer member (554).
10. The implant of any preceding claim, wherein the overall length of the screw member (552) is in the range between about 40 mm and about 110 mm.
11. The implant of any preceding claim, wherein the length of the fusion zone (565) is in the range from about 10 mm to about 37 mm long.
